name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.9.0 — Sprint goals + Stand-up assist. Two new per-role features closing daily-standup and sprint-review Scrum ceremonies. (1) Sprint goal field: a shared optional text field (≤500 chars) in the Sprint Intro card — the goal is displayed at the top of the Planning tab and frozen into history snapshots at confirm time. At validation/confirm, a dialog prompts for outcome (Achieved / Partial / Missed) and an optional retro note; both are stored per-role in the history snapshot and shown in the collapsed and expanded History view. Soft-warn toast if goal is not filled before save. (2) Stand-up assist view: a new '🗣 Stand-up' sub-tab in Planning that classifies sprint tasks into Done / In flight / Not started buckets, per-role, based on the last refreshed snapshot. Done states are admin-configurable in Settings → Stand-up (multi-select from the project state bundle) with automatic fallback to the last 2 positions of State Rollup order. Includes role switcher, sprint goal banner, and a Refresh button. No schema breaking changes; all new fields are optional/additive. 217 unit tests pass. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
